title: A Campus Tour of the New Library
instructions: 听一段关于新图书馆参观的对话，然后回答问题。对话会播放两遍。注意被动语态、顺序连接词以及定语从句和分词短语的辨认。所有场景和数据均为模拟教育材料，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Guide: Welcome, everyone. My name is Sarah, and I'll be showing you around the new library today. The library was built last year and opened to students in September. As you can see, the building is divided into three main areas: the reading zone, the group study rooms, and the digital lab. First, we'll visit the reading zone, which is on the ground floor. Then we'll go upstairs to the group study rooms. Finally, we'll finish in the digital lab, where you can use computers and print documents.
Student: Excuse me, is the reading zone only for silent study?
Guide: Good question. The reading zone is mainly for silent study, but there are also some comfortable chairs near the windows where you can read quietly. However, talking is not allowed there. If you need to discuss something, you should use the group study rooms.
Student: I see. And how do we book a group study room?
Guide: Group study rooms can be booked online through the library website. You need your student ID number to log in. Each room can be used for up to two hours at a time. If you want to book for longer, you have to make two separate bookings.
Student: Are the rooms equipped with anything special?
Guide: Yes, each room has a large screen and a whiteboard. The screens are connected to the library's computer system, so you can show your work to your group. Also, the rooms are soundproof, which means you won't disturb others.
Student: That sounds great. What about the digital lab?
Guide: The digital lab is on the second floor. It's equipped with 50 computers, all of which have the latest software. Printing services are also available there. You can print up to 100 pages per week for free. If you need more, you can buy extra printing credit at the front desk.
Student: Can we use the digital lab without a booking?
Guide: Yes, you can just walk in, but it can get busy during exam periods. It's recommended to check the availability online before you go. Oh, and one more thing: food and drink are not allowed in the library, except in the café area on the first floor.
Student: Thanks for the information. I think I'll use the group study rooms a lot.
Guide: You're welcome. If you have any more questions, feel free to ask at the front desk. Enjoy your studies!

grammar.title: 被动语态、顺序连接词、定语从句与分词短语
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be+过去分词。顺序连接词如first, then, finally用来表示顺序。定语从句用who, which, that等引导，修饰名词。分词短语如V-ing或V-ed形式可以作定语或状语。
grammar.example: The library was built last year and opened to students in September.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The books ______ by the librarian every day.
questions.explanation: 被动语态表示书被检查，主语books是复数，所以用are checked。
questions.evidence: The library was built last year.

questions.prompt: Which sequence word is used to introduce the last step?
questions.evidence: Finally, we'll finish in the digital lab.

questions.prompt: Identify the relative clause in: 'The library, which was built last year, is very modern.'
questions.explanation: 定语从句which was built last year修饰the library。
questions.evidence: The library, which was built last year, is very modern.

questions.prompt: What does the participle phrase 'equipped with 50 computers' modify in: 'The digital lab, equipped with 50 computers, is on the second floor.'?
questions.explanation: 分词短语equipped with 50 computers修饰The digital lab，表示实验室配备有50台电脑。
questions.evidence: The digital lab, equipped with 50 computers, is on the second floor.
